product.title: Highway World — Episode 1: Origin District
product.summary: A 3D sports-business city where eleven missions each force one real front-office call.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students drive between destinations in a stylised city as a basketball front-office decision-maker. Eleven missions — three venue rooms and eight career rooms — each present one forced trade-off on interactive boards: splitting development minutes, working the trade deadline, managing the sheet under the tax line, ranking a draft board where scouting and analytics disagree, negotiating with an agent, pricing the arena. Consequences ripple through six stakeholders and the run ends with a synthesised GM identity review.

delivery.devices: one GPU-capable browser per student; WebGL required

facilitation.prep: The documented classroom unit is a curated two-room hour, not the full eleven missions. An in-app instructor panel supplies a ten-segment run of show.

product.technology: React + React Three Fiber (WebGL), Vite, pnpm turborepo

studentDataProfile.notes: No account server, no email, no password. A local display name and progress are kept in browser localStorage. No telemetry pipeline exists. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: Around 2,700 tests across 225 files, CI with typecheck, full suite, build and two guardrails, and a curriculum spine whose coverage is enforced as a build contract. Its own CTO report recommends shipping only as a supervised pilot, and no student has run it.

health.technicalBasis: No deployment of any kind: no hosting config and no publish step in CI. An instructor would have to clone the repository and run a dev server.
knownBlockers: No deployment — an instructor cannot launch this today without a developer toolchain.

First-load weight of roughly 940 kB of eager JavaScript and 44 MB of 3D assets, which its own CTO report flags as the difference between a good first minute and a teacher giving up on a school network.
No telemetry or observability of any kind.
Some 3D source assets have unclear licensing, pending review.

validation.notes: Every reference to a pilot in the repo describes recommended future work. The file named EPISODE0_PILOT_NOTES is a design audit of retired content, not student data.

governance.notes: Rooms are individually addressable by URL and route-integrity tested, but only the curated two-room hour is documented, timed and scripted. Recorded as one experience for that reason. 'Gold master' here is an internal engineering milestone, not an external certification.

provenance.evidence: README.md: 'the audience is 5th–8th graders' and 'Episode 1 — eight career rooms with a validated curriculum spine — is at gold master.' docs/60-minute-run-guide.md budgets roughly 63 minutes across ten segments for a curated two-room session. packages/engine/src/curriculum/concepts.ts defines 33 concept ids whose coverage is enforced by curriculumSpineInvariantsHold().
openQuestions: Total duration for the full eleven-mission campaign is not stated anywhere; only the curated hour is budgeted.
